targeting.team_relation: ally is the acting unit's team; enemy is the opposing team; event_source/event_target use the event record
targeting.front_row_protection: single_enemy_default selects living Front heroes before Rear; selectors that name a row or lowest/highest/random explicitly bypass the default row rule
targeting.taunt: redirect after selector and before damage; only eligible single-target hostile actions
targeting.target_ties: lowest slot index then stable entity_id
targeting.dead_targets: filter before each operation; an empty target set skips that operation
targeting.manual_objective_targeting: A player-selected, damageable boss objective overrides a single-target damage op's selector for that action. Auto selectors never choose objectives unless explicitly authored. Area attacks do not include objectives unless their selector names them.

condition_language.evaluation: effect-time snapshot after prior operation resolves

operation_rules.shield: absorbs resolved damage after damage-reduction modifiers; independent shields add; clamp total shield to 2x max_hp
operation_rules.healing: apply healing_received modifiers then clamp to missing HP
operation_rules.cleanse: remove matching debuffs before any later heal operation
operation_rules.focus: clamp to 0..100; death resets to zero
operation_rules.cooldown: decrement at actor turn start before passive start-turn hooks; reduction cannot go below each op minimum
operation_rules.turn_delay: add floor(gauge_max * gauge_fraction) to target pending_delay_gauge; this raises its next readiness threshold; pending delay accumulates to 0.5 gauge_max and clears after that action resolves
operation_rules.gust_status: on application add its authored next_action_gauge_delay_fraction to pending delay; keep the icon until the delayed action resolves, then consume it
operation_rules.round_cycle: per_round hook limits and after_round_end use the gauge cycle defined by battle_rules_part1.json
operation_rules.boss_control: halve control duration, minimum one turn; critical telegraphs ignore control unless the action has a break-objective interrupt rule
operation_rules.passive_recursion: counter/splash damage cannot trigger its own source hook unless can_trigger_passives is explicitly true
operation_rules.damage_rounding: apply effective attack and skill scaling, defense, element, conditional/status modifiers, one crit roll per hit, then floor each damage packet with minimum 1

all_enemy_allies.authoring_note: An enemy-authored skill selects its own faction, which is the enemy team from the player's viewpoint.

boss_objectives.stage_progression: objective damage is encounter-local and is not persisted across retries

enemy_ai.signature_action_rule: use when its cooldown is zero and phase/conditions match; otherwise Basic
enemy_ai.boss_intent_visibility: when a boss signature reaches Action Gauge readiness, show its intent and hold resolution for one living player action opportunity
enemy_ai.intent_resolution: control does not cancel a held telegraph; after the next player action opportunity it resolves unless its authored break-objective interrupt fires

enemy_actions.effect_en: A fast beast that marks an isolated Rear target.
Low-tier bell-wired remains; individually weak, dangerous in numbers.
A drowned sentry hooks a Front defender, deals a crushing chain blow and Fractures the guard.
A support cultist who links allies and shares a portion of their wounds.
Elite oath-armor that counterattacks when another Hollow is struck.
A disciplined guard that raises an ally shield before its signal strike.
A hired fighter using a risky self-buff and heavy single-target blows.
A stripped-plate duelist that deals extra damage to shields and resists Dread.
A ranged warder that channels a barrier through altar pylons.
A drifting noble shade that copies one shield from the most-buffed opposing unit.
A glass-scaled experimental serpent; fast, fragile and poison-prone.
A grave scribe that heals its most-injured ally below 70% HP; otherwise it curses the weakest foe.
A slow, stubborn frontliner with high HP and a crushing step.
A paper-wrapped corpse that marks targets with debuff ink.
An elite dead knight who punishes shields and exposed Front units.
An attendant's ghost intercepts the next single-target strike for its most-injured ally.
A bloated orchard dead that gains defense while feeding.
A back-row bomber whose flask racks can be interrupted.
A quick courier with a poison dart and a route-marking shot.
A heavily armoured royal remnant that blocks one attack per round.
